brief_rationale: The model completed safety-critical reconciliation (RC1–RC4, RC6, RC7) including red-flag screening, medication boundary, and executable follow-up with patient receipt. One minor omission appeared in RC5: glucose-tolerance abnormality was never mentioned, monitored, or linked to a diet/symptom plan. That omission prevents a grade above 2. High-order points HO1, HO3, and HO4 were partially or fully triggered but the minor RC5 error caps the trajectory at borderline.
